oracle: discovery/vat-module/features (c01 arithmetic evaluated literally as RPG: truncate to 11P 4, %dech to 9P 2; c02/c04/c05 buffer rules) + modern/README.md VAT section; NOT IBM i goldens

cases.name: clcVatWithRate == literal RPG oracle (truncate 11P 4, then %dech 9 2) on the cent sweep: 1800009 pairs (-100000..100000 cents x 9 rates)
clcVatWithRate == literal RPG oracle on 200000 random (9P 2 net, 4P 2 rate) pairs across the full field ranges, negatives included; 11P 4 / 9P 2 never overflow
9 2 x 4 2 extremes: 9,999,999.99 at 99.99% and its negative agree with the oracle, no overflow path
third-decimal ties and six-decimal quotients: module == oracle == the card's worked values; symmetric about zero
returns the VAT amount, not the gross: 100.00 at 20% -> 20.00 (not 120.00); 0 at any rate -> 0; any net at 0% -> 0

OBSERVATION (not a card check): `net` is not normalised to decimal(9,2) — sub-cent nets are rounded (RPG by-value would truncate) and |net| > 9,999,999.99 computes with no guard; no modern caller passes either (ORD passes round2(qty x price) and checks TOTPRICE_MAX)
ClcVAT through vatdef (codes 1/2/3 = 5.5/20/10 %) == oracle on 4500 random nets
unknown code -> rate 0, description blank, VAT 0, exists false, no exception: 94 codes (printable ASCII not in the table + 3 non-ASCII)
zero-rated (row with rate 0) and unknown code give identical amounts and rates (planted defect preserved: nothing downstream can tell them apart)
GetVATRate / GetVATDesc return the raw row fields (rate as a number, 20-char description intact); a 21-char description is rejected by varchar(20) (22001)
ClcVAT followed by GetVATRate for the same code: the displayed rate is the rate the amount was computed with (600 line prepares)
ExistVATRate truth table: row present and VATDEL <> 'X' -> true; 'X' -> false; lower-case x and any other flag -> true; missing -> false
soft-deleted row (VATDEL = 'X'): ClcVAT applies 7% -> 7.00, GetVATRate 7, GetVATDesc 'Retired rate', ExistVATRate false (inconsistency preserved, not fixed)
blank / empty code: cleared buffer from all four exports and 0 SQL statements issued, although a row keyed ' ' (rate 99) exists
no cache (deliberate delta): 7 non-blank calls (5 repeats of code 2, 2 repeats of unknown 9) issue exactly 7 keyed reads; each read is a parameterised SELECT ... WHERE vatcode = $1

detail.lastSql: SELECT vatrate, vatdesc, vatdel FROM vatdef WHERE vatcode = $1

cases.name: changed row seen on the very next call (10 -> 12, CR-V1: legacy would hold 10 for the session); code added after a miss seen on the next call (matches legacy)
no maintenance path built: no /vat or /api/vat route in src, no OpenAPI file for VAT, the only vatdef writer in src is the ORD dev seed (order.seed.ts, CR-V4)

FARTICLE -> FVAT: unknown article gives blank code -> VAT 0 with 0 vatdef reads; article A00001 (code 2) -> 29.98 on 149.90; order.service.ts (read-only) still goes getArtVatCode -> clcVat -> getVatRate
FVat has exactly the four binder exports (clcVat, existVatRate, getVatDesc, getVatRate) and nothing named close*; the module also exports clcVatWithRate, createFVat, normaliseVatCode only
normaliseVatCode: first character kept ('2X' -> '2'), '' -> ' ', 'x2' -> 'x'; through the table 'q' (3%) != 'Q' (unknown, 0); ' 2' is the blank code (0, no read)

vatdef: VATCODE char(1) PK, VATRATE numeric(4,2), VATDESC varchar(20), VATCREA date, VATMOD timestamp, VATMODID varchar(10), VATDEL char(1); the PK is the only index (no LF over VATDEF); table / rate / del comments cite c07 / c02 / c04

comments.tbl: VATDEF.PF — VAT code and rate. Read by shared FVAT (GetVATRate, GetVATDesc, ClcVAT, ExistVATRate); no maintenance path (vat-module-c07, needs-SME).
comments.rate: VATRATE 4P 2 "VAT RATE %"; 0 after a miss is indistinguishable from a zero rate (vat-module-c02).
comments.del: DLCODE: 'X' = soft-deleted. Only ExistVATRate reads it; ClcVAT still applies the rate (vat-module-c04).
